newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia airfreights first Sukhoi fighters to India.
newsitem.headline: Russia airfreights first Sukhoi fighters to India.

text.p: Russia sent two Sukhoi Su-30K fighter jets to India on Monday, the first of an order for 40 such planes over the next five years, a Russian air force spokesman said.
"The aircraft are being delivered to India from the Siberian city of Irkutsk by Russia's CargoTrans airline," he told Reuters.
The spokesman said that CargoTrans would carry more six fighters by April 7. The company operates Antonov An-124 freighters, each 120 tonnes of capacity, the spokesman said.
Last month the Sukhoi military aircraft maker said that the shipment of Su-30Ks was part of a deal between Russian state arms exporter Rosvooruzheniye and the Indian goverment.
Under the agreement signed last year, Russia will supply 40 such aircraft to Indian Air Force over the next five years at a cost of $ 1.5 to $2 billion.
